mapper.sql: clinic_id, clinic_code, clinic_name, city, address, phone, manager_name, email, area_sqm, open_date, chair_count, status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM clinic ORDER BY clinic_id
SELECT FROM clinic WHERE UPPER(clinic_code) = UPPER(#{clinicCode})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO clinic (clinic_code, clinic_name, city, address, phone, manager_name, email, area_sqm, open_date, chair_count, status) VALUES (#{clinicCode}, #{clinicName}, #{city}, #{address}, #{phone}, #{managerName}, #{email}, #{areaSqm}, #{openDate}, #{chairCount}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE clinic SET clinic_name = #{clinicName}, city = #{city}, address = #{address}, phone = #{phone}, manager_name = #{managerName}, email = #{email}, area_sqm = #{areaSqm}, open_date = #{openDate}, chair_count = #{chairCount} WHERE clinic_id = #{clinicId}
